releaseNotes: Added Player Behavior settings for phone and head unit layouts, including fullscreen after 3 seconds of inactivity and automatic selection of the last channel on startup.
Added fullscreen channel switching with vertical swipes, headset media buttons, and head unit up/down controls.
Improved audio focus so Ph.Live pauses when another app takes audio focus.
Preserved head unit D-pad focus, OK selection, back navigation, and hidden account creation.
